purpose: Recurrence control: Repeats, At and Time zone emit a cron or counted interval with its IANA zone, read back with its next runs, with optional overlap and catch-up selects.
useWhen: Letting a user define when a job or notification recurs, supplying your own date/cron library to compute upcoming fire times.
You want plain repeat choices that still round-trip to a portable cron or interval value, with custom cron one choice away.

avoidWhen.reason: You need jitter or backfill-window controls — those belong to the consumer's surrounding form.
You only need to pick a single point in time, not a recurrence — use date-picker instead.

notes: Repeats is a native select; At is hidden for interval repeats; the time zone is a searchable picker; each custom cron field reports validity via aria-invalid and one associated error.
